name: Syrian American Medical Society Foundation
mission: SAMS is dedicated to delivering life-saving services, revitalizing health systems during crises, and promoting medical education through a network of committed humanitarians in Syria, the United States, and beyond.
theoryOfChange: SAMS is a global medical relief organization that is working on the frontlines of crisis relief in Syria and beyond to save lives and alleviate suffering. SAMS proudly provides dignified medical care to every patient in need. Our Mission is dedicated to delivering life-saving services, revitalizing health systems during crisis, and promoting medical education via a network of humanitarians in Syria, the US, and beyond.  OUR VISION is to strengthen the future of Syria’s healthcare, delivering dignified medical relief where needed, fortified by a dedicated medical community.

strengths_deep_dive: SAMS Foundation exhibits exceptional operational efficiency in high-risk global health environments. In FY2024, the organization achieved a <cite id="3">95.4% program expense ratio</cite>, beating both the 75.0% industry benchmark and the 87.7% peer group median. This fiscal strength is augmented by strong fundraising efficiency, requiring only <cite id="1">$0.02 to raise every $1</cite> in donations. Operatively, SAMS Foundation has documented extensive impact in conflict zones, delivering millions of <cite id="4">total medical services inside Syria</cite> and surrounding refugee-hosting nations.
rich_narrative.summary: The Syrian American Medical Society Foundation provides life-saving medical relief and mental health services to crisis-affected populations globally. Founded in 1998, the organization delivers direct care regardless of religious background or political affiliation. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="3">$61,395,982 in total revenue</cite> to support frontline health initiatives across regions including Syria, Gaza, Jordan, and Ukraine. Demonstrating exceptionally efficient fiscal management, SAMS Foundation achieved a <cite id="3">95.4% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, which surpasses the industry benchmark of 75.0% and exceeds the peer median of 87.7%. The organization operates as a significant direct service provider and grantmaker, distributing <cite id="3">$16,847,661 in foreign grants</cite> to local health programs. While multi-year historical trends demonstrate strong long-term expansion, revenue contracted by 39% in FY2024 from $99,929,862 in FY2023. SAMS Foundation maintains <cite id="2">verified zakat eligibility</cite>, directing zakat donations to eligible beneficiaries in accordance with Islamic principles.
